description: Render multi-line text onto any PNG, JPG or WebP image with configurable anchor position or exact (x%, y%), font style, size, colour, stroke outline, optional rounded background box and opacity. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/add-text-to-image.

align.description: Multi-line alignment: left, center or right

backgroundBox.description: Draw rounded background box behind text

boxColor.description: Background box colour name or HEX

fileContent.description: The file as base64 (a data: URI is fine)

fileName.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.pdf

font.description: Font family: bold, regular, impact, serif or mono

format.description: Output format: same, jpg, png or webp

outline.description: Outline thickness: none, thin or thick

position.description: Anchor: tl, tc, tr, ml, c, mr, bl, bc, br or xy

size.description: Font size as % of image width (1-40)

text.description: Text to draw on the image (newlines supported, max 600 chars)

name: add_text_to_image
title: Add Text to Image API - caption, label or badge photos with outline & box
